def mod_exp(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    n, k, MO = map(int, input().split())
    if n % 2 != 0:
        print(mod_exp(k, n, MO))
        return

    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv_fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MO

    inv_fact[n] = mod_exp(fact[n], MO - 2, MO)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MO

    t = n
    bits = []
    for i in range(21):
        if t & 1:
            bits.append(1 << i)
        t >>= 1

    size = 1 << len(bits)
    S = [0] * size
    for mask in range(size):
        for j in range(len(bits)):
            if (mask >> j) & 1:
                S[mask] += bits[j]

    p = [-1] * size
    for i in range(size):
        t_idx = -1
        for j in range(21):
            if (i >> j) & 1:
                t_idx = j
        p[i] = (1 << (t_idx + 1)) + i

    f = [[0] * size for _ in range(k + 1)]
    f[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(k):
        for j in range(size):
            if f[i][j] != 0:
                k_idx = p[j]
                while k_idx < size:
                    diff = S[k_idx ^ j]
                    inv_val = inv_fact[diff]
                    f[i + 1][k_idx] = (f[i + 1][k_idx] + f[i][j] * inv_val) % MO
                    k_idx = (k_idx + 1) | j

    total_pow = mod_exp(k, n, MO)
    total_ans = 0
    for i in range(k + 1):
        comb = (fact[k] * inv_fact[i] % MO) * inv_fact[k - i] % MO
        total_ans = (total_ans + f[i][size - 1] * comb) % MO

    final_result = (total_pow - total_ans + MO) % MO
    print(final_result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
